source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
As your **[Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase)** ends, each **TYRANIDS SYNAPSE** unit of yours may pick a **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit of yours (not **PURESTRAIN GENESTEALER** or **PATRIARCH**) and a **TYRANIDS** unit of yours, both visible to it and within 9". If it does:

- The **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit takes D3+1 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**.
- One model in the picked **TYRANIDS** unit recovers lost wounds up to the number inflicted.
- Until your next Movement phase starts, that **TYRANIDS** unit's models get +1 to Hit.

Your **TYRANIDS** units have **Catalyst (Aura)**: friendly **GENESTEALER CULTS** units get +1 to Hit when attacking an enemy unit within 6" of such a **TYRANIDS** unit.
